mapper.select: SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER, A.RCP_INF_SEQ, A.ICON_FEE, A.PD_DELI_PAY, A.PD_DELI_PAY + A.ICON_FEE + A.PD_DOSUN_PAY + A.PD_ETC_PAY AS PD_PAY , A.PD_CNT, A.BOSTON_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER, A.RCP_INF_SEQ, A.PD_CNT, A.PD_DELI_PAY, A.BOSTON_CNT , CASE WHEN A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL AND A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL THEN 8000 WHEN A.RECV_ICON_FEE > A.SEND_ICON_FEE AND A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN A.SEND_ICON_FEE WHEN A.SEND_ICON_FEE > A.RECV_ICON_FEE AND A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN A.RECV_ICON_FEE ELSE A.RECV_ICON_FEE END AS ICON_FEE , A.PD_ETC_PAY , A.PD_DOSUN_PAY FROM( SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER, A.RCP_INF_SEQ , CASE WHEN A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL THEN (8000 * A.PD_CNT) + (6000 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 1 THEN (C.FEE1 * A.PD_CNT) + (C.FEE7 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 2 THEN (C.FEE2 * A.PD_CNT) + (C.FEE8 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 3 THEN (C.FEE3 * A.PD_CNT) + (C.FEE9 * A.BOSTON_CNT) ELSE 0 END RECV_ICON_FEE , CASE WHEN A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL THEN (8000 * A.PD_CNT) + (6000 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 1 THEN (D.FEE1 * A.PD_CNT) + (D.FEE7 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 2 THEN (D.FEE2 * A.PD_CNT) + (D.FEE8 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 3 THEN (D.FEE3 * A.PD_CNT) + (D.FEE9 * A.BOSTON_CNT) ELSE 0 END SEND_ICON_FEE , CASE WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 1 THEN A.PD_DELI_PAY + (1000 * A.PD_CNT) + (0 * A.BOSTON_CNT) ELSE A.PD_DELI_PAY END PD_DELI_PAY , A.PD_CNT , A.BOSTON_CNT , A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ , A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ , IFNULL(A.PD_ETC_PAY,0) AS PD_ETC_PAY , IFNULL(A.PD_DOSUN_PAY,0) AS PD_DOSUN_PAY FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_INF A JOIN GOLF_RECEIPT_MST B ON A.RCP_SEQ = B.RCP_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN GOLF_INF C ON C.GOLF_SEQ = A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN GOLF_INF D ON D.GOLF_SEQ = A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ WHERE A.RCP_INF_SEQ IN (SELECT E.RCP_INF_SEQ FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_PAY E WHERE E.ORDER_ID= #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )A )A

SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER, A.RCP_INF_SEQ, A.ICON_FEE, A.PD_DELI_PAY, A.PD_DELI_PAY + A.ICON_FEE + A.PD_DOSUN_PAY + A.PD_ETC_PAY AS PD_PAY , A.PD_CNT, A.BOSTON_CNT FROM ( SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER, A.RCP_INF_SEQ, A.PD_CNT, A.PD_DELI_PAY, A.BOSTON_CNT , CASE WHEN A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL AND A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL THEN 13000 WHEN A.RECV_ICON_FEE > A.SEND_ICON_FEE AND A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN A.SEND_ICON_FEE WHEN A.SEND_ICON_FEE > A.RECV_ICON_FEE AND A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN A.RECV_ICON_FEE ELSE A.RECV_ICON_FEE END AS ICON_FEE , A.PD_ETC_PAY , A.PD_DOSUN_PAY FROM( SELECT A.RCP_NUMBER, A.RCP_INF_SEQ , CASE WHEN A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL THEN (13000 * A.PD_CNT) + (6000 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 1 THEN (C.FEE1 * A.PD_CNT) + (C.FEE7 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 2 THEN (C.FEE2 * A.PD_CNT) + (C.FEE8 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 3 THEN (C.FEE3 * A.PD_CNT) + (C.FEE9 * A.BOSTON_CNT) ELSE 0 END RECV_ICON_FEE , CASE WHEN A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ IS NULL THEN (13000 * A.PD_CNT) + (6000 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 1 THEN (D.FEE1 * A.PD_CNT) + (D.FEE7 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 2 THEN (D.FEE2 * A.PD_CNT) + (D.FEE8 * A.BOSTON_CNT) WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 3 THEN (D.FEE3 * A.PD_CNT) + (D.FEE9 * A.BOSTON_CNT) ELSE 0 END SEND_ICON_FEE , CASE WHEN B.FARE_TYPE = 1 THEN A.PD_DELI_PAY ELSE A.PD_DELI_PAY END PD_DELI_PAY , A.PD_CNT , A.BOSTON_CNT , A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ , A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ , IFNULL(A.PD_ETC_PAY,0) AS PD_ETC_PAY , IFNULL(A.PD_DOSUN_PAY,0) AS PD_DOSUN_PAY FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_INF A JOIN GOLF_RECEIPT_MST B ON A.RCP_SEQ = B.RCP_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN GOLF_INF C ON C.GOLF_SEQ = A.RECV_GOLF_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN GOLF_INF D ON D.GOLF_SEQ = A.SEND_GOLF_SEQ WHERE A.RCP_INF_SEQ IN (SELECT E.RCP_INF_SEQ FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_PAY E WHERE E.ORDER_ID= #{orderId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )A )A

SELECT E.RCP_SEQ FROM GOLF_RECEIPT_INF E LEFT JOIN GOLF_RECEIPT_PAY F ON F.RCP_INF_SEQ = E.RCP_INF_SEQ LEFT JOIN GOLF_RECEIPT_MST G ON G.RCP_SEQ = E.RCP_SEQ WHERE (E.RCP_INF_STAT=0) AND F.PAY_STAT=0 AND F.USER_ID IS not null AND (G.DEL_KIND='2' AND E.SR_TYPE='S' OR G.DEL_KIND='1') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(E.PIC_REQ_DT,INTERVAL #{intervalValue} DAY),'%Y%m%d')=DATE_FORMAT(#{now},'%Y%m%d') AND E.RCP_KIND != '2'
